[{"sha":"7dbaf1829398f1fbca968f054d0079b1837eff46","node_id":"C_kwDOHG8ut9oAKDdkYmFmMTgyOTM5OGYxZmJjYTk2OGYwNTRkMDA3OWIxODM3ZWZmNDY","commit":{"author":{"name":"Sam Moore","email":"sam@paradigmpost.com","date":"2026-10-14T17:48:53Z"},"committer":{"name":"dan","email":"dan@danstepanov.com","date":"2026-10-16T09:04:56Z"},"message":"ci(issue-repro): scope issues:write to jobs that need it

The reproduce-ios and reproduce-android jobs check out and install the
reproduction repo linked in an issue, running its install scripts,
config plugins, Podfile and Gradle build. Those jobs inherited the
workflow-level issues:write token, and actions/checkout persisted it
into .git/config where that code could read it.

- Default workflow permissions to contents: read
- Grant issues: write only to validate and report, which call the
  issues API and do not run untrusted code
- Set persist-credentials: false on every checkout

Artifact upload/download uses ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, so the reproduce
jobs keep working without issues:write.
